    long long sum[11] = {0};
    const long long mod1 = 998244353, mod2 = 1000000007;
    long long cnt = 0, tmp = 0, ans = 0;

    function<long long(long long)> m1 = [&](long long x) {
        return (x % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
    };

    function<void(int, long long)> dfs1 = [&](int x, long long v) {

        ++cnt;
        ve[x].push_back(m1(cnt - v));
        sum[x] += m1(cnt - v);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
            dfs1(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
        }
    };

    function<void(int, long long)> dfs2 = [&](int x, long long v) {
        if (v > n) return;

            if (v * 10 * n > n && v * n + n - 1 <= n) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
                    long long val = m1(cnt - v);
                    auto &vec = ve[i];

                    ans = (ans + val * (long long)vec.size() + sum[i] - mod1 * ((long long)vec.size() - pos)) % mod2;

        }
        for (int i = (x == 0 ? 1 : 0); i <= 9; ++i) {
            dfs2(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
        }
    };

    dfs1(0, 0);
    tmp = cnt;
    cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {

    }
    dfs2(0, 0);
